decisions.reason: Four years after launch, the lack of visible uptake and weaker fit with the firm's infrastructure-led strategic direction likely place this service below aspiration, so resources would be better shifted elsewhere.
Because this network product matches the firm's core fibre and data-centre strengths and had shown adoption, management would likely judge it at or above aspiration and continue it.

Although complementary to the voice business, as a standalone portal it likely delivers limited incremental performance in a maturing voice segment, making withdrawal and integration into broader platforms slightly more likely.
